verdict.rationale: Make is an automation SaaS with AI features (an MCP server and AI Agents), so a data-training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or a no-training commitment. The cited material covers APIs, webhooks, MCP, authentication and audit logs, none of which addresses training use of customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
